$comment: THE LAYOUT, AS DATA (RULE CFG). Every screen edge the builder, the export, the Educo app, the UAT scripts and the tests use is read from here. Change a number here and nowhere else. Rungs: 'from' is the first CSS px of the rung (the cascade runs mobile-first); keep them in ascending order. 'measure' caps a contained column on that rung; 'words' is how the Page check names its screens. heights are the HEIGHT classes (first CSS px of each, ascending: a phone on its side is under 'medium'). shell says which navigation an app screen gets (M3 / NavigationSuiteScaffold): a BAR when the width is under barBelow.width OR the height under barBelow.height, a SIDEBAR from sidebarFrom, a RAIL between; a bar holds at most barMax places (more → the last becomes 'More'); railWidth / sidebarWidth in CSS px (dp); barItemMin is the narrowest a bar place may be (em-px: it grows with the reader's text size) — a bar holds as many places as fit, up to barMax, the rest under More; barClearance is the room a scrolling screen leaves at its foot so its last line clears the bar (none beside a rail). listDetail.splitFrom is the rung where a list and its detail sit side by side (one pane with Back below it); listWidth is the list pane beside a detail (M3: 360dp). appTiles: the Educo app home's quick-action tiles sit as many across as fit at minWidth each (dp at the reader's text size), up to maxAcross. narrowestPhone is the low-cost phone a row must still fit (RULE AF). editor.dockFrom is the editor's own chrome line (panels dock from it), not a rung; labelsFrom / labelsWideFrom are where the top bar's buttons show their words (wide: under a finger, and the right-hand group); brandFrom is where the 'Box Builder' name shows; sheetWidth caps a bottom sheet. webApp.screens are the Educo web app's breakpoints (Tailwind's sm / md / lg… and xs). Tailwind reads all of these through tailwind.config.mjs, so a class says lg: or labels: and never a typed width. uat.edgeHeight is the window height the UAT uses for a rung's edge.
